title: Cantilever column, buckling
description: Steel bar 200 x 20 x 20 mm, end x = 0 fixed, 1000 N axial compression (-x) on the free end. Critical load = load factor x 1000 N.

quantities.label: Euler buckling load, mode 1
quantities.formula: pi^2 E I / (4 L^2) (fixed-free column, effective length 2 L)
quantities.citation: S. P. Timoshenko, J. M. Gere, Theory of Elastic Stability, 2nd ed., McGraw-Hill 1961, Section 2.1 (column fixed at the base, free at the top)
quantities.tolerance_reason: Euler theory leaves out shear deformation (small at slenderness 69), and the end load is a uniform traction, not a point force at the centroid.

quantities.label: Euler buckling load, mode 2 (other direction)
quantities.citation: S. P. Timoshenko, J. M. Gere, Theory of Elastic Stability, 2nd ed., McGraw-Hill 1961, Section 2.1
